name: numeric-conversion-test-6b3e1e5e00/invalid-float-as-byte-256-p.bal
spec_references: ## Expressions: Literal — Currently support `nil-literal`, `boolean-literal`, `numeric-literal` and `string-literal` only
## Module-level declarations: Function definition — Supports required-params
reason: The case asserts that casting float 256.0 to byte panics because the value is outside the byte range. Numeric literals, type casts, local declarations and ordinary function definitions/calls are supported, with no applicable restriction excluding this conversion or its failure behavior.
test_design_notes: The @panic comment marks the expected runtime failure at the conversion.
